# airspy

> Airspy R2, Mini and HF+ — receive-only SDRs with better dynamic range than an RTL dongle

**Vendor:** Airspy

Status: **supported** — the identifiers and setup recipe are believed correct.

**Not maintainer-verified**: nobody on this project has run this hardware yet. The two facts are recorded separately on purpose (D-027) — a correct recipe and a tested device are different claims.

## What it is

A family of receive-only software defined radios. R2 and Mini cover VHF and UHF; HF+ is a separate design aimed at HF and the low VHF broadcast bands.

## What you can do with it

Serious listening. The dynamic range is enough to work weak signals next to strong broadcast carriers, which is where an RTL dongle gives up.

## Setup

Install the packages and add yourself to plugdev. Note R2/Mini and HF+ use different libraries and different USB identifiers, so a working R2 setup does not mean an HF+ will be found.

## Known problems

The HF+ is a different product line despite the shared brand — SoapySDR needs the `airspyhf` package (native tools and the gqrx backend), which this entry already carries — the SoapySDR module for the HF+ is not packaged here, and is not the same module as the R2's `soapysdr-module-airspy`.

## How it identifies itself

| USB id | What | Confirmed | Node |
|---|---|---|---|
| `1d50:60a1` | Airspy R2 / Airspy Mini | yes | libusb |
| `03eb:800c` | Airspy HF+ / HF+ Discovery | yes | libusb |

## Access and permissions

Group membership required: `plugdev` — added at install, applies at next login.

The generated udev rule provides a `/dev/airspy` symlink, mode `0660`, group `plugdev`.
